verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex's own marketing says ops users can run payroll quickly online ("as little as 30 seconds") and submit it in one click, which then handles direct deposits, tax filings and pay stubs. Intelligent Pay Cycle flags issues and AI-suggested modifications help fix missing punches, which implies an hours-review step. However, the evidence is marketing-level and never documents the step-by-step flow or an employer-side preview of payroll totals before submission. missing for 10: documented single-flow workflow covering review of hours/earnings, an explicit pre-submit totals preview, detailed first-party workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end run.
